title: Skull Totem
description: This project retextures the totem of undying to an animated skull
body: This resource pack chnages the totem of undying to an animated skull. Thats it. If the resource pack is at the top of your applied packs page, it will work as expected. If there is a pack above it which has its own texture for the totem, it will not work. ![The Totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82183265d2b71a10caf1cd9c68e354e543eadd6c.gif)
